headline: This week we unveiled an IKEA collection that makes collectible design affordable
context: This week on Dezeen, IKEA shared a first look at its Konstrunda collection, which elevates "everyday objects into art pieces" with contributions from seven designers, including Andu Masebo and Lisa Hilland. The 22-piece collection aims to offer an entry point for young collectors
